```{julia}
using DrWatson
@quickactivate "project"
using StableRNGs
using Distributions
using ConcurrentSim
using ResumableFunctions
using Plots

rng = StableRNG(123)
num_customers = 10

num_servers = 2
mu = 1.0 / 2
lam = 0.9
arrival_dist = Exponential(1 / lam)
service_dist = Exponential(1 / mu)

wait_times = Float64[]
arrival_times = Float64[]
start_service_times = Float64[]
exit_times = Float64[]

@resumable function customer(
    env::Environment,
    server::Resource,
    id::Integer,
    t_a::Float64,
    d_s::Distribution,
)
    @yield timeout(env, t_a)
    push!(arrival_times, now(env))
    println("Customer $id arrived: ", now(env))
    @yield request(server)
    push!(start_service_times, now(env))
    println("Customer $id entered service: ", now(env))
    @yield timeout(env, rand(rng, d_s))
    @yield unlock(server)
    push!(exit_times, now(env))
    println("Customer $id exited service: ", now(env))
end

function setup_and_run()
    sim = Simulation()
    server = Resource(sim, num_servers)
    arrival_time = 0.0
    for i = 1:num_customers
        arrival_time += rand(rng, arrival_dist)
        @process customer(sim, server, i, arrival_time, service_dist)
    end
    run(sim)
end

setup_and_run()

mkpath(plotsdir())
mkpath(datadir())

wait_in_queue = start_service_times .- arrival_times
plot(1:length(wait_in_queue), wait_in_queue,
    xlabel = "Номер клиента", ylabel = "Время ожидания",
    title = "Время ожидания в очереди M/M/c",
    marker = :circle, legend = false)
savefig(plotsdir("mmc_wait_times.png"))

println("Готово! Среднее время ожидания: ", sum(wait_in_queue)/length(wait_in_queue))
```
